title: DocuDrop — Blocked, But Only Once
objective: A straightforward '../' is blocked this time. Use an encoded form of the same sequence to escape the receipts directory anyway.

verifier.condition: The download endpoint returns content outside the receipts directory from a filename whose literal text never contained the string '../'.

weakness: The filter rejects the literal string '../' before the framework's own URL-decoding has fully run, so an encoded or double-encoded traversal sequence reaches the file lookup unfiltered.
vulnerableEndpoint: GET /download?file= (filtered for the literal substring '../' only)
seededData: The same simulated filesystem as the basic traversal lab, in a separate instance.
hints: A literal '../' is now rejected outright — confirm that first.
A URL can represent the same character more than one way. What's the percent-encoded form of a forward slash and a period?
If the filter runs before decoding finishes, try encoding the sequence more than once.
burpNotes: Try %2e%2e%2f in place of ../ in Repeater. If that alone doesn't work, try double-encoding each character (%252e%252e%252f) to survive an extra decode pass.
